speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for coming in. You mention sudden-onset lower back pain radiating down your leg; to help me understand the severity and cause, please describe exactly where the pain travels and if you noticed any specific incident or injury before it started.

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Radiculopathy (likely L5 or S1 root compression due to acute disc herniation).

The mechanism of injury (exercise) and radiation to the foot are highly suggestive of a herniated disc. To confirm this, I will request imaging of the lumbar spine. REQUEST IMAGES: Lumbar_Spine_MRI.
